title: Today
q_decide: What did you decide, and why? Reply with your decision to preview the note change.
q_grade: What actually happened, compared with your prediction? Reply with the outcome and lesson.
q_complete: Has this commitment been completed? Apply marks it complete. Edit changes its wording.
q_review: What does this evidence confirm or change? Reply with your observation.
blocker: This has been deferred twice. What is blocking it, or what smaller step could you take? Your answer will be recorded as a blocker, without completing the original item.
effect_decide: Apply records this decision and sets its status to decided.
effect_grade: Apply records this outcome and marks the decision graded.
effect_review: Apply records your observation in the review history. The source stays unchanged.
effect_blocker: Apply records the blocker and pauses this item for seven days. It stays unresolved.
effect_revise: Apply replaces only this task's wording; its source and date stay unchanged.
empty: Nothing needs attention in this queue today.
week: Last 7 days: {decide} decisions recorded, {grade} outcomes recorded, {complete} commitments completed, {review} evidence reviews, {blocker} blockers recorded.
source_missing: The source is missing or private; no changes were made.
source_changed: The source changed since this item was prepared. Rebuild the queue tomorrow or review the source directly; no stale draft was applied.
expired: This control is out of date. Use the latest Today message.
already_handled: This item has already been handled.
edit_prompt: Reply with the revised wording or answer. I will show a preview before applying it.
date_required: Reply with a future date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
reason_required: Reply with a short reason for dismissing this item.
answer_required: Reply with an answer first (up to 1,800 characters); I will show a preview before applying it.
task_single_line: Keep the task wording on one line, without a pipe separator.
completed: Commitment marked complete by the owner.
applied: Applied and recorded in the Today history.
dismiss_saved: Dismissed with your reason. The source was not changed.
transcribe_failed: I could not transcribe that answer. Please reply with text or try the recording again.
unavailable: The Today queue could not process that response. Nothing was treated as a new capture; please try again.
